same_names_elsewhere.note: On the west side of Reading, a stub cut by the plate edge is labelled '...WAY' (probably RIDGEWAY). This is the west part of Ridgeway, offset about 180 px SW: a jogged crossing.

reads.note: RIDGEWAY comes from the NE, bends and meets the east side of READING (between lots 3224 and 3302). The point is where its last WNW segment meets Reading's centreline/track.

Same place as t04_69 (same plate, almost the same region). Narrow Ridgeway (RIDGEWAY) comes from the ESE and ends in a T on the east side of broad Reading (READING) next to a hydrant. The point is Ridgeway's centreline extended to Reading's track/centreline.
